## Review summary

Created with AI, based on recent reviews

Considering 619 reviews, most reviewers were somewhat happy with their experience overall. Consumers generally find the shopping process very straightforward, often praising the exceptionally fast shipping times and the simple, stress-free unboxing experience right out of the box. Many people truly appreciate that the equipment is lightweight, extremely easy to move around tight home spaces, and features whisper-quiet motors during daily walking workouts.

However, some customers also noted frustrating issues with products arriving damaged or missing essential components necessary for proper assembly. A few reviewers additionally experienced unexpected mechanical failures over time, noting that walking belts stopped working entirely or motors finally quit after a few months of regular use.See more
